answer: The wander detector writes to quartz, and relic makes public every merge. Submissions that land within 284 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. A farm scripting its whole army of identities fires them together, so that the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 163 aliases out burns the operator real scheduling effort per key. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
